children: The U.K. government is expected to exercise prudence in spending plans and revenue generating measures during the budget statement on October 28, Capital Economics' Joe Maher says in a note. "The threat of a bond market backlash will probably keep the government from loosening fiscal policy by much." The government could raise borrowing only marginally to avoid a negative response in the gilt market, Maher says. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
